## Sessions

::: {.callout-tip title="Principles"}
- Distinguish in-class demo, in-class exercise, and homework.
  One file for each (with different sheets).
  Solutions are in a separate `_solution.xlsx` file.
  Use the solutions file only to generate screenshots for the teaching notes.
  Develop solutions interactively in class.
- Python code should be included through ``{{< include _demo.py >}}`` in teaching notes to avoid duplication.
- Make sure that all homework is properly discussed at the beginning of the next session.
:::

See [objectives](objectives.qmd)
